name: resistance band seated leg curl
description: A seated hamstring curl using a resistance band anchored in front of you. It isolates the back of the thigh.
instructions: Anchor the band at foot height and sit facing it.
Loop the band around your heels.
Extend your legs straight in front of you.
Curl your heels back under the seat against the tension.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the end.
Return slowly without letting the band snap.
